# generated by scripts/changelog.ts from the CHANGELOG.md files of the packages
version: 0.17.0
date: 2026-11-19
---

### Added

- Add hooks to the template features, so a template can bring its own header actions, menu and lunch top, event list and header, page header and lists of posts, people and documents, and restyle header, notice, footer and dishes through stable `data-*` names. ([#122](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/122))

### Changed

- Change the Markdown parser to comark 0.9 and math to KaTeX 0.19 (a site that installs `katex` itself needs `^0.19.1`); bare URLs and domains in text still become links. ([#125](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/125))
- Change platform images to be files of the deployment: a build writes every image the published content names, and an image added later is fetched once and then cached for all regions. ([#126](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/126))

### Fixed

- Fix a production build that never ends: the templates look up their optional files with a relative `import.meta.glob` pattern. With an aliased pattern (`~/…`), rolldown before 1.3 could block all its worker threads on a build machine with two cores, so the client build stopped at "transforming..." until the host's time limit. ([#124](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/124))
